create_extension_manager: create an ExtensionManager instance to build a plugin registry for swapping implementations at runtime
register_extension_class: register a class with ExtensionManager.register decorator using a string name key
load_extension_by_name: load and instantiate a registered extension class by name with ExtensionManager.load passing args and kwargs
build_plugin_system: build a pluggable extension system by registering multiple classes and loading them by name at runtime
test_extension_registry: test ExtensionManager.register and load methods verify class registration and instantiation by name
